text:
Sam: Heads-up team  Skyline beta opens next Tue. We need final enrollment, GDPR consent path for EU accounts, renewal risk flags, and a lightweight feedback plan. Goal: 3 waves (~100 seats), AE-personalized invites for VIPs, two webinars (tech + product).

Ivy: I'll assemble the CSV. Columns requested? email,company,owner,seat_count,timezone,renewal_tag,consent_status,flags,pre_survey_intent.

Ramon: Add 'ae_contact' so invites can auto-fill personalization. Also we need a column 'eu_consent_required' (true/false) so legal can send the consent flow for EU accounts.

Sam: Good call. We must not send in-app modals before consent for EU. If eu_consent_required=true, route to consent email template first.

Zoe: I'll own survey cadence: pre-survey (single Q use-case), day4 micro-NPS + 1 free-text, and week3 deeper feedback + interview opt-in. Day4 will be in-app for non-EU, email-based for EU who haven't given consent.

OnboardBot: Reminder: playbook "skyline-invite-runbook" scheduled 2026-04-09T16:00Z. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.co/skyline/invite-runbook.md

Ivy: Uploaded CSV: https://drive.redwood.co/skyline/enrollments_final.csv (101 rows). Sample row: 
```
anna@acme.com,Acme Corp,Leila,5,PST,renewal_90,false,skyline_flag:true;vip_support,false
```

Carl: Dev note: we'll gate by flag skyline_flag and add event hooks: first_successful_call, vector_index_created. I will push a small dashboard tile to CS > Skyline > Adoption today.

Ramon: Invite sequencing plan: batches of 30 every 90 minutes per region. VIP template sends immediate AE note + calendar link. Non-VIP uses standard invite. If an invite bounces, mark row as bounce and swap to AE manual invite.

Sam: For renewal risk, any account with renewal_30 AND pre_survey_intent=low should be escalated to AE for a quick renewal-health check within 48 hours of invite.

Zoe: Incentives: 25 gift cards reserved for interview opt-ins. I'll handle distribution and tracking sheet.

Carl: Example invite call (devs can reuse):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.co/v1/invites \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"email":"{{email}}","template":"skyline-vip","flags":["skyline_flag"],"ae":"{{ae_contact}}"}'
```

Ivy: Note: CSV has 18 EU rows with eu_consent_required=true. Legal will send consent email template; we will only provision accounts after consent_received=true. Please do not auto-send in-app surveys for these rows.

Sam: Owners recap: @Ivy = enrollment CSV + consent handoff, @Carl = invite plumbing & instrumentation, @Zoe = surveys + incentives, @Ramon = invite sequencing + AE routing, @Sam = overall run & escalations.

Ramon: Risk: several corporate ITs may block calendar invites from redwood.co. If so, we fallback to AE manual invites and a self-serve onboarding link. I'll annotate the CSV with 'calendar_block_risk' where known.

Zoe: I'll prepare two survey copy variants (in-app short + email fallback) and post both here by EOD.

OnboardBot: Action scheduled: "skyline-invite-batch-1" 2026-04-11T14:00Z. Throttle policy: 30/hr/region; fallback to self-serve if queue>150.

Carl: Deploy note: instrumentation endpoints are live /telemetry/events and dashboard tile pushed at 2026-04-08T20:12Z. Ping me if you need additional metrics.

Sam: Thanks team. Final go/no-go check tomorrow 09:00 PT. If legal flags consent template changes, @Ivy please surface immediately. :rocket:
